title: 'feat(radar): add `clockwise` option'
category: feature
requirement: '## Context

  Radar charts currently assume a single indicator ordering direction, which makes it awkward to match designs or domain conventions that expect the indicators to progress clockwise.

  ## Desired outcome

  Radar coordinate systems should support a `clockwise` option so authors can choose the direction in which indicators are laid out.

  ## Acceptance signals

  Setting `radar.clockwise` changes the indicator ordering direction without breaking label placement or the rest of the radar rendering contract.

  '

content.text:
Plan written to `/workspace/agent_plans/radar-clockwise-option.md`. Repo untouched otherwise (`git status` shows only `agent_plans/`).

Key findings from reading the actual source:

- `/workspace/src/coord/radar/Radar.ts:20` still carries a literal `// TODO clockwise` marker — the feature was never implemented.
- `/workspace/src/coord/radar/Radar.ts:143-149` hard-codes the direction: `let angle = (this.startAngle + idx * Math.PI * 2 / this._indicatorAxes.length);`. Since `coordToPoint()` (`Radar.ts:90-96`) negates y (`const y = this.cy - coord * Math.sin(angle);`), increasing angle means counter-clockwise on screen, so clockwise layout needs a `-1` step sign.
- `RadarOption` (`/workspace/src/coord/radar/RadarModel.ts:58-63`) and `defaultOption` (`:178-190`) have `startAngle` but no `clockwise`.
- **No view change is needed.** `/workspace/src/component/radar/RadarView.ts:44-57` passes `rotation: indicatorAxis.angle` per axis into `AxisBuilder`, and `AxisBuilder` derives all name/label alignment purely from `cfg.rotation` + extent (`innerTextLayout` at `AxisBuilder.ts:588-616`, `endTextLayout` at `:1019-1047`, name `graphic.Text` at `:913-940`). The clockwise angle set is a mirror of the counter-clockwise set, so label placement is preserved by construction. Split-area ring polygons (`RadarView.ts:129-165`) stay counter-wound relative to each other, so fill is unaffected. `radarLayout.ts` and `RadarSeries.ts` are index-driven.
- `/workspace/src/export/option.ts:22` re-exports `RadarOption`, so the public typing surface updates automatically — no `index.d.ts` edit.

Decision flagged as the main open question: I set the default to `clockwise: false` to keep existing charts pixel-identical, even though every other ECharts component with `clockwise` defaults to `true` (`polar/install.ts:43`, `PieSeries.ts:220`, `GaugeSeries.ts:209`, `SunburstSeries.ts:227`, `ChordSeries.ts:308`). Flipping that decision is a one-literal change.

Tests are feasible: `test/ut/jest.config.cjs` already matches `**/spec/coord/**/*.test.ts` (the `spec/coord` dir doesn't exist yet). The spec asserts through `coordToPoint()` rather than raw `indicatorAxis.angle`, because the `Math.atan2(sin, cos)` normalization makes signs at ±π floating-point fragile.

input.risk: Main unknown is the default value: I specified `clockwise: false` to preserve current rendering (every existing radar chart stays pixel-identical, since dirSign===1 reproduces today's arithmetic exactly). Upstream may have chosen `true` for consistency with polar/pie/gauge/sunburst/chord, which all default `clockwise: true`; if so, only the one literal in RadarModel.defaultOption plus two spec assertions change — the mechanism is identical. Secondary: `Radar.pointToData` has a pre-existing wrap-around bug in its nearest-axis search (`Math.abs(radian - angle)` at Radar.ts:114) that is direction-agnostic and deliberately left untouched. Split-area polygon winding flips with clockwise; canvas/SVG ring fill is winding-symmetric so no visual change is expected, but `shape: 'polygon'` + `splitArea` is the case to eyeball in the visual test.
input.summary: Add a `clockwise?: boolean` option to the radar coordinate system, defaulting to `false` (current counter-clockwise behavior). `RadarModel.ts` declares the option on `RadarOption` and adds `clockwise: false` to `defaultOption`; `Radar.ts` gains a public `clockwise` field read in `resize()`, and the per-indicator angle step becomes `dirSign * idx * 2PI/n` with `dirSign = clockwise ? -1 : 1` (negative because `coordToPoint` negates y, so growing angle is counter-clockwise on screen). The stale `// TODO clockwise` marker at Radar.ts:20 is removed. No change is needed in `RadarView.ts` or `AxisBuilder` — label/axis-name placement derives solely from `cfg.rotation` per axis, and the clockwise angle set is a mirror of the counter-clockwise one, so indicator 0 stays at `startAngle` and every label is laid out by the identical code path.
